notes.title: Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin - Vote on Greenlight!
notes.content:
UPDATE:

Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin had been Greenlit and is currently available on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/454130/

My latest game, entitled Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin, is currently on Greenlight for voting. Please do take a look at it through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=554088148]this link[/url].

Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin is a pseudo 8-bit action platformer. It combines much of the gameplay aspects of the previous titles in the series in a manner that differentiates it from its predecessors, minding the feedback received on those titles through Steam reviews, forum posts, and Let's Play videos.

notes.title: Update - Version 1.5.3.6
notes.content:
This update is quite small but the changes I've made are ones that I feel are worth mentioning and are of the following:

- The player character now withstands multiple attacks that were once fatal upon one blow when playing with either the "Easy" or "Normal" difficulties selected.

- Minor tweaks with movement
